- End

Transitions:
- Patient Registration -> Consultation Request
- Consultation Request -> Prescription Request
- Prescription Request -> Lab Request
- Lab Request -> Prescription & Invoice Look-up
- Prescription & Invoice Look-up -> End

Guards:
- Patient Registration: <= 4 seconds
- Consultation Request: <= 2 seconds
- Prescription Request: <= 2 seconds
- Lab Request: <= 4 seconds
- Prescription & Invoice Look-up: <= 4 seconds

Events:
- Patient Registration
- Consultation Request
- Prescription Request
- Lab Request
- Prescription & Invoice Look-up

Lifecycle:
- Start
- End

Mode-switching behaviour:
- From Start to Patient Registration
- From Patient Registration to Consultation Request
- From Consultation Request to Prescription Request
- From Prescription Request to Lab Request
- From Lab Request to Prescription & Invoice Look-up
- From Prescription & Invoice Look-up to End
